name: ExcelLent — Logistics Automation Challenge
event: From Paper to Data: Logistics Automation Challenge
imageAlt: ExcelLent web interface converting PDF, Word, CSV, and TXT logistics files into structured Excel spreadsheets
summary: Local-first document extraction pipeline turning complex shipping contracts and PDFs into structured multi-sheet Excel workbooks.
description: Built during the 'From Paper to Data: Logistics Automation Challenge' organized by Oltek Solutions Corp. ExcelLent automates the extraction of multi-thousand-row freight contracts, trade lanes, and container rate tables from unstructured PDF, DOCX, CSV, and TXT documents into formatted Excel reports.
bullets: Extracted 2,172+ structured trade-lane and container tariff rows from complex freight PDF contracts
highlights: Extracted 2,172+ structured trade-lane and container tariff rows from complex freight PDF contracts into formatted .xlsx reports.
techStackContext: Engineered backend solutions utilizing advanced Python architectures. Implemented robust data parsing algorithms and structured technical workflows to optimize data processing.
